facts.fact: The Births and Deaths Registry published its 2022 Statistical Report: Death Registration, which presents statistics on deaths registered in 2022 drawn from all 261 districts; the preface calls it the inaugural statistical report by the Registry; as_of is the publication date 2024 (copyright 2024), the figures cover 2022.

note: Passages only (6,642 words); no stated regularity (report called inaugural), so no series fact.
